articleBodyHtml:
Speaker's Emotional State and Relationships

The speaker is feeling okay, as indicated by their statement, 'yeah look at who i'm okay.' They also express fondness and acknowledge the progress of others, saying, 'i missed you missed you guys too and you're doing so good you're a natural shiodi.' Additionally, they admit to being confused and relieved about surviving a dangerous situation, stating, 'no no i'm just ditzy i was surprised that i didn't die from that tentacle thing that b-boo tried to.' The speaker is also grateful for the teacher's guidance, saying, 'trick me into yeah right now you're doing great thank you that's because i got a good teacher.'
